product_summary: Motwane (est. 1909, Mumbai) is an Indian manufacturer of electrical Test & Measurement equipment, not an IT/electronics trader. Verified from its own site (motwane.com homepage and /products-and-services/): (1) Test & Measurement division — high-precision electrical test instruments for power, railways, defence, oil & gas, cement, steel and OEMs (product-level pages not reachable in this session, so individual models unverified); (2) Telemetrics — cable fault locators for power cables, communication cables and water pipelines (acquired company, 30+ years); (3) IoTx — IoT transformer monitoring device; (4) IoXn series — smart street lighting (CityLight), smart transformer monitoring (IoTx), smart chiller monitoring (IoCH), smart water meters (IoWM); (5) MOT-WARE — SaaS test-data platform; (6) Motwane AI Analytics; (7) Motwane Digital Oil Testing Services / transformer oil testing lab; (8) Entrance & Access Control business; (9) Motwane Academy (training). Declared HS 854370 ('electrical machines and apparatus having individual functions, n.e.s.') is a residual code that could at best cover some IoT/electronic sub-assemblies, but it does not describe the core line, which is measuring and testing instruments (Ch. 90).
role_hint: manufacturer (own R&D and manufacturing of test & measurement equipment since 1909; also holds acquired brand Telemetrics and runs a service lab — no trader signs found on the site)
comment: HS 854370 vs actual range: PARTIAL / effectively wrong for the main product line. Motwane's declared core is electrical test & measurement instrumentation, which belongs in HS Chapter 90 — 9030 (instruments for measuring electrical quantities), 9031 (measuring/checking instruments n.e.s.), 9032 (automatic regulating/controlling instruments, relevant for IoTx/IoXn monitoring devices) — plus 9027 for the oil-testing lab instruments and 9028 for smart water meters. 854370 is a residual 'individual function' code and can only plausibly cover some IoT gateway/electronic modules, not the analysers, test sets and fault locators that are the company's actual output. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: the company stays in the base, the code is corrected to the factual range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry misclassification: the declared industry 'IT и электроника' is inaccurate — this is electrical/power test & measurement engineering (power, railways, defence, oil & gas), with a software/SaaS layer (MOT-WARE, AI Analytics) that is a secondary, not primary, line. Product lines missing from the declaration: cable fault locators (Telemetrics), transformer oil testing services/lab, smart street lighting (CityLight), smart water meters (IoWM), entrance & access control, and training services — none of these are covered by 854370. Trader signs: none observed; the site presents own R&D, own manufacturing and own product brands, so role = manufacturer. Evidence status: the product families above are corroborated by the company's own website pages (https://www.motwane.com/ and https://www.motwane.com/products-and-services/), but no customs line or shipment record was checked in this task (out of scope), therefore every HS mapping here is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the customs-line level. Individual model numbers and their technical specs could not be retrieved (product sub-pages returned 404 / binary content in this session), so the HS-6 list is a range derived from product families, not from a verified model catalogue. No registry, revenue, PAN or shipment data was researched per task scope; those fields are null.
